rows.ja: 供給元(Viaviの年次報告に記載)

companies.name: ビアビ・ソリューションズ

relations.text: Viaviの年次報告が、顧客例の1社としてCienaを挙げている
relations.text_en: Viavi's annual report lists Ciena among its example customers

source.label: Viavi Solutions 10-K
source.quote: Examples of our customers include Advanced Micro Devices, Inc., América Móvil, AT&T Inc., British Telecom Openreach, Ciena, Cisco Systems, Inc., Deutsche Telekom AG, Ericsson, Lumen Technologies, Inc., Nokia Corporation and Verizon Communications Inc.

relations.text: AT&Tへの売上は、2025年度で5億70万ドル(売上高の10.5%)だった
relations.text_en: Sales to AT&T were $500.7 million, or 10.5% of total revenue, in fiscal 2025

source.label: Ciena 10-K
source.quote: Sales to AT&T were $500.7 million, or 10.5% of total revenue, in fiscal 2025, and $475.3 million, or 11.8% of total revenue, in fiscal 2024.

relations.text: AT&Tは、Cienaの全事業セグメントから製品とサービスを購入している
relations.text_en: AT&T purchased products and services from each of Ciena's operating segments

source.label: Ciena 10-K
source.quote: AT&T purchased products and services from each of Ciena’s operating segments for each of the periods presented.

relations.text: データセンター内外の相互接続分野への拡大に伴い、今後Broadcomとも競合する見通しと説明している
relations.text_en: Ciena says that as it expands its interconnect strategy it will begin to compete with Broadcom

source.label: Ciena 10-K
source.quote: In addition, as we advance our interconnects and market expansion strategy to address needs inside and around the data center, we will begin to compete with additional competitors, including Marvell Technology Group, Credo Technology Group, and Broadcom.
